title: HTS stellarator model coil
blurb: A first-of-a-kind high-temperature superconducting demonstration magnet: long-lead superconductor tape, precision coil casing, cryostat, power and protection systems, ending in a cold test campaign.
disclaimer: Illustrative case. Site footprint follows public information; suppliers are anonymised and all durations and performance data are synthetic. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the company.
